# IJRAR - International Journal of Research and Analytical Reviews

> IJRAR is a UGC-CARE approved, peer-reviewed multidisciplinary open-access research journal with international indexing and publication services.

IJRAR (International Journal of Research and Analytical Reviews) is an established academic publishing platform offering research paper submission, peer review, and indexing services across multiple disciplines. The journal maintains UGC-CARE approval and is indexed in major databases including Scopus, Web of Science, CrossRef, and Google Scholar.

## Key Topics

- UGC-CARE approved
- Peer-reviewed journal
- Multidisciplinary research
- Open-access publishing
- ISSN/E-ISSN indexed
- Impact factor journal
- DOI/CrossRef registration
- Research paper submission
- Call for papers
- Publication guidelines
- Scopus indexing
- Web of Science
- Google Scholar
- ISBN/ISSN assignment
- Best paper awards

## Submission & Publication

- [Call for Papers](https://ijrar.org/callforpaper.php): Call for papers and submission guidelines for IJRAR journal
- [Paper Submission Portal](https://ijrar.org/submitonline.php): Online paper submission portal for IJRAR research journal
- [Author Login](https://ijrar.org/Authorhome/alogin.php): IJRAR author login portal for manuscript tracking and submission
- [Book Publication Services](https://ijrar.org/bookpub.php): Book and thesis publishing services with ISBN/ISSN assignment
